2024_general.fact: Neither the Current Election page (/214/Current-Election) nor the Archived Election Results page (/549) lists any file for the Nov 5 2024 general election (archive page jumps from Nov 2025 and May 2025 to March 2024). Wayback harvest for taylorcounty.texas.gov failed (robots_disallowed_or_unreachable); no sweep folder; a web search found no county or third-party file. UNDETERMINED.

2026_primary.fact: Current Election page, 'JOINT PRIMARY ELECTION March 3, 2026': Early Voting Results (DocumentCenter 5012/5013, PDF created 7:24-7:25 PM CST), '1st Release Election Day Results' (5015/5014; Republican page header 'Republican Party - Cumulative Report ... Unofficial Results ... Run Time 9:02 PM Run Date 03/03/2026', Precincts Reporting 0 of 68, with Election Day Voting column; scanned PDFs created 9:10 PM CST), 'Final Unofficial Results' (5016/5017; 'Run Time 10:37 PM' Dem and '10:35 PM' Rep, Run Date 03/03/2026, 68 of 68, scanned PDFs created 10:47 PM CST). All are county-wide Cumulative Reports (6 and 10 pages). The only precinct reports are 'OFFICIAL Precinct Report' 5042/5043 ('Official Results', PDF created Mar 10 and Mar 11 2026). DocumentCenter returns no Last-Modified header, so no upload time; the printed run times decide (rule 43): county totals on election night, precinct numbers only at canvass: LATER, county_totals_first_seen 2026-03-03 21:02 CT.

2026_runoff.fact: No May 26 2026 runoff results are linked on the Current Election or Archived Election Results pages (the Nov 3 2026 section links DocumentCenter 5196/5197, which are the June 13 2026 City of Abilene runoff, Run Time 8:13 PM 06/13/2026). No archive captures. UNDETERMINED.

rationale: Only the March 2026 primary is determined (LATER from check 2, election-night printed run times on county-totals reports, precinct report only official). Fixed rule with one determined election: COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS, confidence low.
